Maya L.: Hey team — quick design review request for the API Keys page. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frame 'CTA & Warnings'). Maya L.: Main questions: 1) primary CTA placement between Create/Rotate, 2) how to surface revoke (danger) vs disable (soft), 3) empty-state copy for org admins. Screenshots attached. Sam K.: I think Create should be the primary action. Rotate is rare for users and feels like a less-important operation. Revoke is destructive and should be behind a modal + use a red button. Sam K.: Also: consider moving Rotate into the kebab menu or make it a small secondary button to reduce visual weight. Julian M.: Accessibility nits: when the revoke modal opens, focus must land on the heading; trap focus; set aria-modal=true. For success/failure we should use an aria-live region (polite for success, assertive for errors). Julian M.: Example snippet for toast aria-live: ```
API key rotated
``` Aisha R.: Copy note: "Revoke" reads very technical and final. Suggest we use "Deactivate" for the soft choice and keep "Revoke" only for permanent destructive action. Also, make the revoke modal title explicit: "Permanently revoke API key?" Oliver B.: Backend FYI — 'last used' info is available but expensive to compute for full lists. We can lazy-load per-page or add a small icon that fetches on hover. Don't surface invites/other user emails without extra ACL checks. Oliver B.: If you want a column, we should show a skeleton loader and fetch in the background to avoid blocking render. product-bot: Heads-up — small A/B will run next week to test primary CTA on the left vs primary CTA on the right (experiment id: keys_cta_order_202). Maya L.: Proposed microcopy + affordances: - Primary page CTA: "Create API key" (primary, left-aligned) - Row actions: kebab menu with -> Rotate (secondary), Revoke/Deactivate (danger) inside menu - Revoke modal copy: "This will stop all requests using this key immediately. This action cannot be undone." CTA: "Permanently revoke key" (red). Secondary: "Cancel" - Add undo toast: "Key revoked — undo" (10s) to allow quick recovery for accidental revokes. Maya L.: Empty state suggestion for org admins: "No API keys yet. Create a key to start using the Redwood API. Need rotation policies? Learn more." Primary CTA: "Create API key"; secondary link: "Rotation & policies" Sam K.: +1 on undo toast. Also propose we show a small warning badge on keys that haven't rotated in >180 days. Aisha R.: UX microcopy tweak: swap 'Permanently revoke key' to 'Permanently deactivate key' — "revoke" felt heavy to some reviewers, but I'm fine with the stronger wording if legal wants it. Julian M.: Keyboard flow check: ensure kebab menu is reachable via keyboard and that menu items are focusable and actionable with Enter/Space. Also test with screen reader — the revoke modal must announce the reason text. Oliver B.: Implementation note: undo requires soft-delete semantics in the backend (we have it), but purge must be scheduled. I'll add an API to expose soft-delete window. Maya L.: Thanks — I'll update Figma with these changes and add focused a11y checklist. I'll also draft two copy variants for legal to review: using "revoke" vs "deactivate". Sam K.: Quick design ask: can we make the kebab menu icon larger on mobile? Right now it's small and hard to hit. Maya L.: Good call — adding a touch-size guide. Will follow up with screenshots. Aisha R.: Looks good to me otherwise. :+1: Julian M.: Will run keyboard/screenreader pass after the next mock is updated. Oliver B.: I'll wire up the lazy-load endpoint and add skeletons. product-bot: Note: experiment rollout scheduled Tue 09:00 UTC. Maya L.: Thanks everyone — feel free to drop final tiny comments on the Figma frame. Closing cross-checks by EOD Thursday?
